airdrops.about: SolPump Airdrop Details SolPump operates a continuous airdrop system that rewards active community members and players through multiple mechanisms. The platform distributes hourly airdrops to eligible participants who engage with the chat community and maintain betting activity. To qualify for these hourly distributions, users must have wagered at least 0.001 SOL within the past hour, ensuring that rewards go to active participants. The airdrop pool grows dynamically as players place bets on crash games, with a percentage of all wagers contributing to the community reward pool. This creates a sustainable reward system where increased platform activity directly benefits all participants. Additionally, new users can claim free Solana cases worth up to 10 SOL by using affiliate codes and connecting their social media accounts. In one of the latest updates, the SolPump team has announced their native token. Read more about the token below.

airdrops.about: DAC Quantum Chain Airdrop Details A DAC token airdrop has not been officially confirmed by DAC Labs. That said, the project is running a QE points program on its L1 testnet with leaderboards, badges, and multipliers — the same mechanics most L1s use ahead of a retroactive token distribution. Early participants who farm QE, complete missions, and rank on the leaderboard are positioning for a potential reward once the token generation event happens.
